name: Mus
description: Mus is a popular Spanish game of Basque origin, played by four players in partnerships. It is unusual among vying games in that it is played without money and with partnerships. The game involves drawing cards and betting on who has the best hand in four categories: Grande (high), Chica (low), Pares (pairs), and Juego (game). It features extensive bluffing and a complex system of signals.

content.text: Mus is a popular Spanish game of Basque origin, played by four players in partnerships. It is unusual among vying games in that it is played without money and with partnerships. The game involves drawing cards and betting on who has the best hand in four categories: Grande (high), Chica (low), Pares (pairs), and Juego (game). It features extensive bluffing and a complex system of signals.

Mus originated in the Basque region of Spain. The name may derive from the Basque word 'musu' meaning 'kiss' or from the Spanish 'mus' meaning 'muzzle'. It became one of the most popular card games in Spain.
4 players in fixed partnerships, partners sitting opposite each other.
40-card Spanish pack. Suits: Swords, Batons, Cups, Coins. Cards: Rey (King), Caballo (Horse/Queen), Sota (Jack), 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, Ace. Note: 3s are equivalent to Kings, 2s are equivalent to Aces.
40-card Spanish deck, small stones or counters (piedras) for scoring.
4 cards to each player, one at a time, anticlockwise. The player to dealer's right is the 'mano' (first to speak in betting).
